peak_audit.scope: Frozen production observables; no IQ regeneration. Fixed-period diagnostics and all local maxima of the original full grid. Ranks of fixed points mean 1 + number of refined maxima with larger score, not actual candidate membership.
peak_audit.predeclared_harmonic_probe: 70m only; run H=1,2,4 with same 1800-14400s grid, all five channels, no LOS, same folds and weights, no truth-based winner selection; all winners reported. Exploratory cached-feature reruns only, not validation on independent data.

noise_manifest.validation: CSV/raw identity, 9100 unique keys, 91 summary moments and 273 success counts rechecked; 273 selected scalar scores agree to 5e-12; frozen import paths asserted; local clean centroid CV maximum agrees to 0.001 s.
noise_manifest.missing: No SNR > 30 dB generated; no new IQ, global search or causal ablation run.

noise_channel_scores.scope: Frozen feature reuse; original full searches not rerun; selected, true and archived top competitors rescored with frozen scalar SVD.

noise_centroid_nonaffine.scope: 100-trial mean at each CPI, unweighted affine fit to noiseless centroid; SEM is across independent trials for each CPI. CPI dependence is retained; no global independent-CPI significance test.

noise_local_followup.scope: Frozen features; local [13200,13600] s bounds chosen post hoc for mechanism diagnosis; no blind search or universal optimization guarantee.
